craft_notes: Sthāyin: seal — received teaching. Sanskrit-first: passive kept (was told). Rows: 2. Close: teller unnamed-but-Highest (fork LIVE carried, both readings covered). Rejected: choosing Śiva over preceptor — killed: fork LIVE, owner adjudicates. Read aloud: sealing cadence — telling settles, teller recedes.

lines: Thus it was told, this homecoming to your nature —

reads_against.argmap: Sealed as received teaching; teller held open (fork LIVE).
c1_essence: Sealed as received teaching from the Supreme One.
